confidence_notes: Holistic estimates from general knowledge of Helsinki prices, not checked against live menus, rates or listings; may lag 2026 changes. Dining and cafe anchors are moderately reliable; July lodging is less certain given summer demand swings. Cocktail and wine were set from approximate direct knowledge and cross-checked against the beer anchor (about 1.9x and 1.5x). The 13 Oct 2026 FX value comes from a search-result summary attributed to the RBA Exchange Rates page; the RBA table was not opened, a second search could not reproduce it, and no 14 or 15 Oct RBA observation was found. Verify before use.
comparable_city_reasoning: No single comparable city; benchmarked to Nordic capital price levels (Stockholm, Copenhagen, Oslo), with Helsinki set somewhat below Oslo and Copenhagen on dining and lodging. July lodging reflects peak summer tourism demand.
